title: Advanced Algorithms
prerequisites: To enrol in this course, you must have completed COMP6466 or COMP3600 .
requisite_raw: To enrol in this course, you must have completed COMP6466 or COMP3600 .  Incompatible with COMP4600 .
description: This course covers a large spectrum of algorithmic topics such as approximation algorithms, randomized algorithms, parallel/distributed algorithms, and online algorithms. Students will learn how to analyze the most fundamental algorithms in these areas using various techniques from graph theory, probability theory, and algebra. After successful completion of the course, students will be able to design efficient and effective algorithms for similar problems leveraging these techniques. Furthermore, students will learn about the most recent research advancements in these areas by studying current research publications.
learning_outcomes: Display a deep understanding of classical approximation and graph algorithms and their analysis.
Analyse the efficiency and correctness of randomized algorithms and data structures.
Demonstrate a good knowledge of parallel, distributed, and online algorithms.
Design and analyse efficient algorithms using various advanced algorithmic techniques such as linear programming, graph theory, probability theory, and algebra.
Understand, analyse, summarize, and present research publications in the area of algorithm design.
